grades.quote: Debuggers can use the `C.EBREAK` instruction, which expands to `ebreak` , to cause control to be transferred back to the debugging environment.
grades.reason: Directly identifies a software breakpoint instruction and its debugging effect.

grades.quote: executing the BREAK instruction will trigger a breakpoint exception immediately.
grades.reason: Directly identifies BREAK and its breakpoint exception behavior.

grades.quote: Instruction address breakpoints have the same cause value as, but different priority than, data address breakpoints (a.k.a. watchpoints) and environment break exceptions (which are raised by the EBREAK instruction).
grades.reason: Identifies EBREAK as raising an environment-break exception, providing useful supporting information about breakpoint exceptions.
